definition: Independent checks for scripts/40_eta_sensitivity.py (code: aux_checks/indep_checks.py, aux_checks/post_final.py). part1: lib.cvae_torch.train_cvae retrained at eta 0.01/0.1/1/0.001 vs this script's weights; part2: numpy forward pass on the stored selected eta=10 models (regenerated sample arrays, collapse stats, calibration); part3_4: every eta model re-scored with separately written numpy code + mechanism diagnostics (dead encoder ReLUs on training days; RMSE of the decoder at z=0; R^2 of active posterior means on [temp_smooth_n, pca_temp_0-2, pos_y, work_day, #Low, #High]; spread/skill and coverage90 if the Gaussian decoder noise implied by the loss, sd = sqrt(eta/2) on the [0,1] scale, were added iid); part5: linear-VAE bound, unit k can be active at the optimum only if eta < 2*lambda_k (lambda_k = eigenvalues of the second-moment matrix of the scaled training residuals around the collapsed eta=10 seed-0 decoder at z=0).
